en: Black‑and‑white photograph of a ballerina in a long, light-colored classical tutu performing on an outdoor stage before a very large crowd. The dancer is in an elegant arabesque pose, facing a dense audience that fills the entire background. Behind the crowd are rows of trees, flagpoles with raised flags, and large multi‑story buildings with traditional European architecture. A large statue or monument is visible to the left in the distance.
